resources.string: Detect installed apps that declare standard FCM/GCM receive components, then verify their HyperOS Autostart state when the ROM exposes it.
Tap Scan FCM apps to build the local list.
%1$d FCM apps detected. HyperOS did not expose readable Autostart state on this build. Use Configure all in HyperOS.
No user-facing FCM apps were detected.
HyperOS Autostart settings could not be opened
App settings could not be opened
Advanced and optional: grant Shizuku access to change the two HyperOS Autostart AppOps for a selected FCM app. This does not start USB debugging.
Shizuku is authorized. Tap a scanned app\'s Autostart status to switch it.
Start Shizuku first, then return and grant access. On non-root phones Shizuku itself needs its own user-started ADB or wireless-debugging session after reboot.
Shizuku controls require Android 6.0 or later.
Command completed, but HyperOS did not expose a readable result. Check it in HyperOS settings.
Autostart status is read-only and best-effort. Unknown means HyperOS blocked or did not expose the vendor AppOps query; FCM Guard never treats Unknown as Disabled.
Default: follow the system. This changes only the UI theme and adds no background work.
